fusions.name: Glinting Scatter
fusions.desc: Looses 3 darting hoppers at once, spread apart, each one dealing 4 damage. For 2 seconds after, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Breaching Mass
fusions.desc: The whole cloud packs into one dense ball and dives into the first enemy it meets, dealing 30 damage, and 80% of that to every other enemy within 3.5 tiles. Each hit has a 60% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip the Net
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 7 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 15% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Never Quite Caught
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, an attack that would have hit you is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
